summary: Two human-layer sub-bugs from capstone T-0647. (A) task-detail drawer: was leaking machine keys as PRIMARY values («Шаг: legal_precheck», «Инстанс: agent:», «Ключ процесса: telLinear») and never showed the source RECORD. Now: «Шаг»/«Текущий шаг» render through the NEW StepRef primitive (step-level sibling of ProcessRef/ActorChip — human step name primary, raw BPMN node id DEMOTED to a mono chip); an explicit «Запись» row renders the source record's title+link via the REUSED RecordRef (T-0648); the raw instance-UUID + procKey are collapsed into a single demoted «Идентификаторы» line (no bare «Инстанс»/«Ключ процесса» primary rows). The inbox LIST row now carries record context on the task NAME (RecordRef, so the 8× identical «Проверить: агенту…»/«Подача заявки» names are distinguishable) and humanizes the step subtitle via the SAME deriveStepLabel. (B) registry_def «набор полей»: the first «Настроить поля» for an app with zero sets forced «+ Новый набор полей» before ANY field could be added — the internal registry_def abstraction leaked. Now the schema screen auto-opens the create-editor seeded with a default set («Основные поля») when the app has zero sets, so the operator lands directly on the field list; server auto-slugs it (osnovnye-polya) via the existing T-0650 path. Client-only — no server/DB delta.
deviations_from_adr: No ADR authored (P2 UI task, sibling of T-0683/T-0684/T-0648). Followed the established human-layer pattern verbatim: pure exported decision helper (isMachineStepKey/deriveStepLabel) + kit primitive (StepRef) + honest demotion, exactly mirroring deriveProcessRefPrimary/ProcessRef.

REUSE not new resolvers: RecordRef (T-0648) resolves the source record TITLE client-side (lazy GET /api/records/:id, PDP/tenant enforced by that endpoint) — used unchanged in the drawer's «Запись» row and the list name. StepRef is a NEW component but is a thin sibling of ProcessRef, not a new resolver — it consumes the step string the projection already carries (task_step). No server resolver added; the projection's definitionName (resolveDefinitionNames path, T-0614) already feeds the human process name.

B: auto-create is a client-side auto-OPEN of the existing create-editor seeded with a default name, NOT a new server route. It POSTs to the existing POST /api/registry-defs with only display_name (slug omitted → server auto-generates, T-0650). Idempotent by construction: the auto-open latch (autoOpenedRef) fires at most once per app, and only while the app has zero sets — once any set exists (or the user cancels) it never re-fires, so it can never plow a second default set.
friction_events: Worktree had no node_modules — ran `npm ci --maxsockets=3` at root AND `npm install` in web/ before any gate could run (web tier needs its own react/@vitejs install).

anti-case-lock (rights-ui-anti-case + detel-literal-baseline) flagged case-literals I put in NEW comment/test lines — EXACTLY the T-0683 friction. Two hits: (1) a multi-line JSX `{/* */}` comment in screen-inbox.jsx contained the literals 'telLinear'/'agent:' — the gate's comment-strip only recognizes lines starting with //,*,/* so a wrapped comment continuation line counts as CODE; reworded the comment to drop the literals. (2) I used 'Согласование счёта · узел Проверка' as a human-step test example — 'Согласование' is on the rights-ui-anti-case FORBIDDEN_LITERALS list; replaced with the neutral 'Проверка реквизитов · этап A' (still reads human: space + «·» + Cyrillic). Gate + self-test green after both fixes.

The StepRef component-tree test initially asserted the raw key was 'NOT a bare text leaf' anywhere in the tree — wrong, because the DEMOTED MonoId chip legitimately renders the key as secondary text. Corrected the test to read the PRIMARY name span (className chs-stepref__name) in isolation and assert the key is absent THERE (never primary), while separately confirming it stays reachable in the demoted chip.

reuse.RecordRef_T0648: Reused unchanged for the drawer «Запись» row AND the list task-name record context — same lazy GET /api/records/:id + PDP/tenant-safe title derivation, no new resolver.
reuse.resolveDefinitionNames_path_T0614_T0683: The projection's definitionName (from the resolveDefinitionNames batch) still feeds the drawer's human process name — untouched; StepRef only humanizes the step string that path already carries.
reuse.ProcessRef_T0683: Left in place in both the drawer and list Процесс column; StepRef is its step-level sibling (same isMachine*/derive* split), not a replacement.
reuse.T0650_auto_slug: The auto-«main» set reuses the existing POST /api/registry-defs slug-omitted auto-generation — no slug logic added.

auto_main_idempotent: YES. shouldAutoOpenDefaultSet returns true only when defs loaded AND length===0 AND editor closed AND not-yet-auto-opened. The autoOpenedRef latch (a ref, reset only on appId change) makes the auto-open fire at most once per app; once any set exists length>0 makes it false permanently. So the create POST happens at most once from the auto path, and a repeat name would 23505→409 anyway — but the latch means the repeat never even fires. A user cancel keeps the latch set and drops to the honest empty-state (manual «Новый набор полей» still works).
friction_findings: recordId reachability: A's record context depends on InboxItem.recordId / projection.recordId, which are present ONLY for processes started via on_create from a record (T-0414/T-0356). Manually-started processes and legacy defer rows carry no recordId — the drawer «Запись» row and the list name RecordRef are simply omitted for those (honest absence, not a broken link). This is the same limitation T-0683's ProcessRef record disambiguator already has.

The drawer projection section still shows the raw instance-UUID + procKey (now demoted under «Идентификаторы») rather than removing them entirely — kept for operator/support traceability, but never as leading/primary rows. If a future task decides these carry zero operator value they can be dropped without touching the humanized rows above them.
